title: Karnataka High Court says arrest of Gameskraft founders was illegal
description: The Karnataka High Court on Tuesday declared the arrest of Gameskraft founders Deepak Singh, Vikas Taneja, and Prithviraj Singh by the Directorate of Enforcement (ED) to be illegal and directed their release from jail [Deepak Singh v Directorate of Enforcement and connected matters].Justice M Nagaprasanna pronounced the verdict today. "Writ petitions are allowed. Arrest of these petitioners is declared contrary to law. As a consequence thereof the petitioners shall be set at liberty forthwith. T
